In this work, sustainable European sourced feed stock material shall be used to produced thermosetting resin to be used in combination with carbon fibres to enable composite part manufacturing by out of autoclave process that will exhibit recyclable, repairable and reusable capabilities. This includes extended pot life resin, 100% biobased resin, REACH compliant resin and vitrimer-based resin. Composites based on carbon fibre will be produced using sustainable resin and tested to reach TRL 4 first at sample level and thenat breadboard level representative of existing mature design for space. The activity will also assess the environmental benefits of the proposed materials and processes through LCA, comparing them against conventional composite manufacturing approaches. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Review of the different out of autoclave processes existing for space applications, - - - - - - Review of the commercially available sustainable resins that could be used for out of autoclave processes, Performing a trade-off taking into account materials/processes compatibility, sustainability aspect of the resin, capability to enable composite recycling, reuse and repairability Select at least 2 different out of autoclave processes for further investigation, Development of test plan at sample level to assess the performance of the chosen material and process, Design, produce and test 2 demonstrators based on relevant composite parts for space applications, Perform simplified LCA and Ecodesign trade off and selection.Deliverables:Breadboard, Report
